questions.question: In standard edited English, a singular present-tense subject usually takes which verb form?
choices: a plural verb form
an infinitive only
a singular verb form
no verb

questions.question: Which sentence has subject-verb agreement?
choices: The list of supplies is on the desk.
The list of supplies are on the desk.
The list of supplies be on the desk.
The list of supplies were on the desk today.

questions.question: Which sentence uses the correct pronoun case?
choices: Maya and me finished the report.
Me and Maya finished the report.
Maya and myself finished the report.
Maya and I finished the report.

questions.question: Which sentence uses a possessive pronoun correctly?
choices: The blue folder is their’s.
The blue folder is theirs.
The blue folder is them.
The blue folder is they.

questions.question: Which verb tense is consistent?
choices: Yesterday we walk to the store and bought fruit.
Yesterday we walked to the store and bought fruit.
Yesterday we walked to the store and buy fruit.
Yesterday we walking to the store and bought fruit.

questions.question: Which sentence uses the comparative form correctly?
choices: This route is more shorter than the old one.
This route is shortest than the old one.
This route is short than the old one.
This route is shorter than the old one.

questions.question: Which sentence uses an adverb to modify a verb?
choices: The runner moved quickly.
The quick runner won.
The runner’s quickness surprised us.
The runner was quick.

questions.question: Which sentence uses an adjective to describe a noun?
choices: The comet moved brightly.
The comet shines brightly.
We saw a bright comet.
Brightly, the comet appeared.

questions.question: Which sentence has a clear pronoun reference?
choices: When Jo met Kim, Jo shared the notes.
When Jo met Kim, she shared the notes.
They told them that they were late.
It said that it was ready.

questions.question: Which sentence uses the correct verb form?
choices: The class have finished its project.
The class are finished its project.
The class has finished its project.
The class finishing its project.

questions.question: A writer changes from past tense to present tense without a reason. What should an editor check?
choices: spelling of proper nouns only
tense consistency
point of view
paragraph length

questions.question: Which revision removes a misplaced modifier? “Walking to school, the rain soaked Amir.”
choices: Walking to school, the rain soaked Amir.
The rain, walking to school, soaked Amir.
Amir soaked walking to school the rain.
Walking to school, Amir was soaked by the rain.

questions.question: Which sentence uses parallel structure?
choices: She likes hiking, to bike, and swimming.
She likes to hike, biking, and to swim.
She likes hikes, biking, and to swim.
She likes hiking, biking, and swimming.

questions.question: Which sentence correctly uses “fewer” in standard edited English?
choices: Less students missed the bus this week.
Fewer students missed the bus this week.
Fewest students missed less buses.
Fewer water remained in the bottle.

questions.question: Which sentence uses “who” as the subject of a clause?
choices: The student whom called left a message.
The student whose called left a message.
The student who called left a message.
The student which called left a message.

questions.question: A student writes, “Each of the players have a locker.” Which verb agrees with the subject in standard edited English?
choices: has
have
are
were

questions.question: Which revision makes the comparison logical? “Our team scored more points than the other team.”
choices: Our team scored more points than the other team’s.
Our team scored more points than the other team scored.
Our team scored more points than the other team is.
Our team scored more points than them.

questions.question: Which sentence avoids an unclear pronoun?
choices: She placed it beside it.
They put it near that.
Lena placed the map beside the compass.
It was beside the one.

questions.question: A sentence begins, “The principal, along with the counselors, ___ attending.” Which verb fits standard edited English?
choices: is
are
were
have

questions.question: Which revision best corrects “The reason is because the bus was late”?
choices: The reason is because was late bus.
The reason because the bus was late is.
The reason are that the bus was late.
The reason is that the bus was late.
